<fidel-help>

Help in the same place. A "Get help" button that lists the help routes you give, text first: chat, email, an interpreter video call, phone.

Who it helps:ማንን ይረዳል፦ Everyone; text comes first, so Deaf learners are never sent to a phone line.

Live exampleየቀጥታ ምሳሌ

This example is live: try it with the keyboard, a mouse or touch, and a screen reader.ይህ ምሳሌ ቀጥታ ነው፦ በኪቦርድ፣ በማውዝ ወይም በንክኪ፣ እና በስክሪን አንባቢ ይሞክሩት።

Code to copyየሚቀዳ ኮድ

<fidel-help chat-url="https://t.me/example_help" email="help@example.org"
            video-call-url="https://meet.example.org/interpreter" phone="+251 11 000 0000"
            hours="Monday to Friday, 8:30 to 17:00"></fidel-help>

Source: player/src/components/c/help.js

Attributesመለያዎች (attributes)

Attributes of <fidel-help>
AttributeValuesDefaultMeaning
chat-url, email, video-call-url, phoneURL, address, URL, numbernoneThe routes (at least one; none = nothing shown).
hourstextnoneWorking hours, shown in the dialog.
ui-langen, amthe page's lang, else enLanguage of the component's own buttons and messages.

Eventsክስተቶች (events)

Events sent by <fidel-help>
Eventevent.detailWhen
fidel-help-open{}The dialog opened.
fidel-help-choose{ route } (chat, email, video, phone)A route was chosen.

Events bubble and carry no personal data. Listen with addEventListener, like any DOM event.

Keyboard and screen readerኪቦርድ እና ስክሪን አንባቢ

  • "Get help" opens a dialog of real links. Escape closes it and returns focus to the button.

Languagesቋንቋዎች

Its own buttons and messages are in English or Amharic. Set ui-lang="am" on the tag (or on a parent); without it, the page's lang is used, else English.

Accessibility and WCAGተደራሽነት እና WCAG

  • 3.2.6 Consistent Help: Supports when you put it in the same place on every page.

The full WCAG 2.2 AA conformance report
